caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing figure with brown skin, positioned barefoot on a circular green base. The figure is adorned with a short skirt decorated with red, green, and gold feather-like patterns, and a gold diagonal sash crossing from the left shoulder to the right hip. A circular band decorates the figure's upper right arm. The figure's head is accessorized with a large, elaborate headdress featuring multi-colored plumes in shades of green, red, and gold, held by a golden band. Both arms are bent at the elbow, with the right arm extended forward, hand posed as if holding or gesturing towards something, and the left arm resting by the side. The overall composition centers the figure against a plain, light beige background.
title: Cigar Store Indian
